title.original: Memori: A Persistent Memory Layer for Efficient, Context-Aware LLM Agents
title.zh: Memori：高效的上下文感知LLM代理的持久内存层
title.en: Memori: A Persistent Memory Layer for Efficient, Context-Aware LLM Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: Memori 以模型无关 API 层实现三元组抽取、摘要存储和紧凑召回，为跨模型会话提供持久记忆基础。
inclusion_reason.en: Memori implements triple extraction, summary storage, and compact recall at a model-agnostic API layer, supplying persistent memory across models and sessions.

abstract.zh: Memori 是模型无关的 API 层持久记忆，把原始多轮对话转化为紧凑语义三元组和会话摘要。Advanced Augmentation 流水线以结构化表示支持跨模型、跨会话的精确召回，减少把完整历史重复注入提示的 token 成本。
abstract.en: Memori is a model-agnostic persistent-memory layer at the API boundary that converts raw dialogue into compact semantic triples and conversation summaries. Its Advanced Augmentation pipeline enables cross-model, cross-session recall without repeatedly injecting full history.

problem.zh: 现有记忆常锁定供应商，或把大量原始对话塞回上下文，造成 token 成本、噪声和跨模型迁移困难。
problem.en: Existing memory often creates vendor lock-in or reinjects large raw transcripts, increasing token cost and noise while making cross-model portability difficult.

approach.zh: Advanced Augmentation 从对话抽取实体—关系—值三元组并生成会话摘要，查询时检索少量相关结构和摘要，为任意兼容 LLM 组成紧凑上下文。
approach.en: Advanced Augmentation extracts entity–relation–value triples and session summaries, then retrieves a small relevant subset to assemble compact context for any compatible LLM.

system_design.zh: Memori 拦截 API 对话流，异步执行结构化抽取并写入持久层；请求前检索器选择三元组与摘要，增强器将其注入目标模型而不依赖供应商会话格式。
system_design.en: Memori intercepts API dialogue, structures and persists it, then retrieves triples and summaries before a request and injects them into the target model without relying on a vendor session format.

key_results.zh: LoCoMo 评测报告 Memori 以远小于完整上下文的 token 数获得较高准确率，并比其他记忆方案进一步减少输入成本。
key_results.en: On LoCoMo, Memori is reported to achieve high accuracy with a small fraction of full-context tokens and to use fewer tokens than competing memory systems.

limitations.zh: 三元组抽取会丢失语气和复杂时序，错误结构可能长期固化；摘要未说明冲突更新、用户删除、抽取成本或非对话工具状态。
limitations.en: Triple extraction can lose tone and complex temporal relations, while incorrect structure may persist; conflict updates, user deletion, extraction cost, and non-dialogue tool state are not described.

metrics.name: token reduction vs competing memory systems

notes.zh: LoCoMo、两类基线和准确率/token 结果来自官方摘要；模型、硬件、竞争系统名称和成本计算待全文审计。
notes.en: LoCoMo, two baseline classes, and accuracy/token results come from the official abstract; models, hardware, competing system names, and cost calculations await full-text audit.
